The background shows a modern, minimalist indoor living space with beige curtains and a white pedestal fan on the floor. (3) An extreme close-up shot focuses on the man's left nipple. The left side is labeled as 'Before' and the right side as 'After,' showing a noticeable difference in the pinkness and hydration of the skin. Finally, the man is seen standing upright, now wearing glasses, in front of a white door with a decorative red tassel hanging on it. He holds the pink bottle up to the camera while laughing heartily, his body posture relaxed and animated.
